title: @PDXWiIT Can you please share this event widely in your network? We have the 9th annual #IndieWeb summit coming up June 28-29th: https://2019.indieweb
summary: @PDXWiIT Can you please share this event widely in your network? We have the 9th annual #IndieWeb summit coming up June 28-29th: https://2019.indieweb.org/summit and would love to get everyone involved. Great time for developers to take control of their narrative.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @PDXWiIT Can you please share this event widely in your network? We have the 9th annual #IndieWeb summit coming up June 28-29th: https://2019.indieweb.org/summit and would love to get everyone involved. Great time for developers to take control of their narrative.
